author: musho7-dev
subject: Pause menu: bigger buttons with more space between them
body:
Wider card with more padding, larger text, and taller, well-spaced
buttons (Resume 92 px, Restart/Garage 78 px with an 18 px gap, End run
68 px) so they're easy to hit with a thumb on the phone.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
